arxiv-2208-08793.title: Shear hardening in frictionless amorphous solids near the jamming transition
arxiv-2208-08793.creator: Deng Pan, Fanlong Meng, Yuliang Jin
arxiv-2208-08793.description: Abstract The jamming transition, generally manifested by a rapid increase of rigidity under compression (i.e., compression hardening), is ubiquitous in amorphous materials. Here we study shear hardening in deeply annealed frictionless packings generated by numerical simulations, reporting critical scalings absent in compression hardening. We demonstrate that hardening is a natural consequence of shear-induced memory destruction.

pmc-10652268.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023).
